sampling_unit: B2 is a bounded article list, not a claim to all news published worldwide
uniform_rule: Same source frame for every real/fake/current session; retain every query/result and rejection reason; all included primary-frame headlines will be manually reviewed in seeded shuffled order
reason: Initial broad headline-rule QA exposed individual advice/domestic-price stories and heterogeneous content farms. Source frame set before reading B2 outcome counts; no tone-rate comparison used to choose sources.
limitations: Relative/unknown publication days are not fabricated
